svg.aria-label: Automated playtesting workflow and the six bugs it found
svg.title: Automated playtesting workflow and the six bugs it found
svg.text: A robot played the game and found 6 real bugs
then GitHub runs the same robot on every change (CI)
Boss bullets flew over the player's head
Hunters became impossible to shoot up close
The minimap was a mirror image of the world
Health packs were wasted at full health
Memory leak: about 50,000 objects every minute
Holding an arrow key turned only one small step
